_comment: Demo quest proving the JSON-driven procgen path end-to-end. on_start fires generate_interior with a small INLINE recipe (no file dependency, so it exercises ParseRecipe directly). The F10 debug hotkey fires spell_cast_on{victim}, whose trigger fires generate_structure (from the recipe_keep.json file) + rearrange_furnishings. NOTE: this is loaded by SkyrimAdapter::StartDemoQuest only if you point it at this file; by default the adapter loads demo_court_wizard.json. See the test plan in the agent report for how to swap it in, OR just use the three spells (which need no quest).
title: Procgen JSON demo

build_lab.text: Procedurally generate the wizard's workshop via JSON

on_start.show_message: (Generating a small cottage in front of you via JSON...)

recipe._recipe_note: Verified vanilla FormIDs (Skyrim.esm), cross-checked against the eldersouls furnishing console-code guide; mirrors config/procgen/recipe_cottage.json. EditorIDs (DefaultCandleLight01NS / Tankard01) are MEDIUM confidence and skip-with-warning if absent.

triggers._comment: F10 (debug) fires spell_cast_on{victim}; here we reuse it to build a keep from the file recipe + then rearrange the inline room's furniture.

do.show_message: (Generating a small keep via JSON + rearranging the cottage furniture...)
